chunks: 40 – Al-Mu'taqal ibn Umar, al-Ju'fi, Abu Abdillah.
He is thiqa (reliable) in himself according to me, but his hadiths are all munkar (unrecognized/ distinct), and nothing is cleared from his hadith that is permissible to rely upon.
ai.seo_question: What is the status of Al-Mu'taqal ibn Umar as a narrator in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry from Kitab al-Du'afa discusses the narrator Al-Mu'taqal ibn Umar al-Ju'fi. The author considers him reliable in himself (thiqa nafsan) but notes that his hadiths are generally munkar (weak or distinct) and none are sufficiently sound to be relied upon for legal rulings.
